title: Reject invalid multipart geometry before geographic regression normalization

labels.name: type:engineering
labels.description: Application, database, geography releases and infrastructure

labels.name: status:ready
labels.description: Reviewed scope and dependencies ready for a worker claim

body:
Raised 2026-10-06 (America/Los_Angeles). Follow-up to completed #920; parent #1202, milestone 3 lasting prevention. This is a bounded engineering implementation, not geography source research or an atlas repair.

A bounded read-only replay of actual merged 09f557dd650098e3b6b89fab5950ac9fe5ef8809 found an invalid candidate MultiPolygon accepted as `no-new-regression`, 0 findings and no geometry errors. Two valid constituent boxes overlap by 1.0000000000276037e-18 square degrees. `scripts/evidence/geometry.py:54-81` validates each constituent separately, then `union_all` dissolves the invalid multipart overlap. The subsequent multipart-overlap rejection only fires above `max(1e-6 m², area(result)*1e-10)`. The original candidate's invalid structure is therefore silently normalized before `scripts/check-geographic-regression.py` compares coverage. This contradicts #920's invalid-polygon/no-implicit-repair acceptance; it is not evidence that all gates are missing or that all existing shapes are invalid.

Existing enforcement is real: `.github/workflows/merge-integration-checks.yml` runs trusted immutable base-vs-head; `.github/workflows/worker-merge.yml` independently runs current-base-vs-combined-candidate. `scripts/merge-integration.mjs:314,331-347` requires exact geography success and bound artifact, including when application test proofs are reused. The whole world-index footprint inventory enters neighbor closure. Literal new positive-area lost coverage and pair overlaps use no sliver cutoff. Source-only research with unchanged live input blobs receives explicit not-applicable, not a geometry approval. A reviewed full-shape physical-water loss adjudication is now implemented in current code despite stale wording in `docs/GEOGRAPHIC_REGRESSION.md`.

Acceptance (max 1 PR):
- Preserve the existing declared shortest-source-edge/dateline longitude interpretation. Validate combined multipart topology in that supported longitude domain before union/dissolving can erase the defect; do not substitute naive raw flat-longitude validity for the accepted date-line method. Reject invalid topology including shared-edge contact with zero overlap and positive overlap below the existing helper tolerance. Do not introduce size/area exemptions, snapping, MakeValid, automatic fill or ownership inference. Preserve the complete raw geometry, stable ID, immutable containing-file hashes, method/domain and actionable diagnostic.
- Preserve exact baseline defects and vintage distinctions. A previously invalid baseline is not retroactively declared valid or repaired. Explicitly test unchanged defective baseline, valid correction of a defective baseline, and changed candidate defects, retaining blocked/unknown treatment where comparison cannot safely establish a valid result. Do not quietly weaken global validation to make current inputs pass.
- Directed controls must replay the actual tiny overlap and prove failure before union; retain positive valid disjoint multipart and point-touching multipart controls. Shared-edge contact that is invalid OGC MultiPolygon topology must remain an explicit defect rather than be relabeled valid. Test individually invalid polygon, holes, dateline short-edge support, supported valid joint neighboring repair, and exact unchanged valid geometry. Retain the original raw pointsets and declared longitude interpretation together with the pre-union supported-domain diagnostic.
- Exercise trusted PR and combined-candidate enforcement, fail-closed artifact/status/immutable-code behavior, and source-only not-applicable behavior. Core footprint integration/import/build paths must be tested; no claim that polygon validation alone certifies raster allocation, release consistency, water, ownership, historical claims or deployment.
- Update only directly affected guidance so it describes the actual strict reviewed water-adjudication path and the corrected multipart validation. No new generic gate framework, source imports, threshold waiver, production writes or browser use.
- Retain code/input/runtime pins, meaningful controls and bounded reproduction; obtain distinct substantive exact-head implementation/geometry review; pass applicable CI and ordinary serialized merge lifecycle. No self-review or premature source/physical/global milestone completion.

Reproduction: baseline Polygon bbox [0,0,0.000002,0.000001]; candidate MultiPolygon consisting of boxes [0,0,0.000001,0.000001] and [0.000001-0.000000000001,0,0.000002,0.000001]. Both constituent polygons are valid, entire candidate is invalid. Runtime Python 3.12.14 / Shapely 2.1.2 / GEOS 3.13.1 / PyProj 3.7.2. Exact existing script/helper hashes and actual replay output are preserved locally pending durable author delivery; this draft itself does not claim an implementation or completed repair.
